title: About 50 spoken words is the CDC figure for 30 months
summary: CDC lists about 50 words among what most children say by 30 months, and the word about is printed on that line.
body: On the 30-month CDC sheet, one communication entry reads that the child says about 50 words. About is part of the printed line, so 50 is not a sharp cutoff. The sheet does not describe a diary, a picture inventory, or a clinic procedure for arriving at the figure. Pronouns such as I, me, and we are a separate entry on that sheet and are not this tally. A form written outside the United States can use a different tally. Missing the figure is not, by itself, a diagnosis the sheet makes.
